findings.text: the re-export shim, the one path imas-ambix still consumes, has no test asserting its names or the done-when's nova.io.cocos.transform_factor is nova_cocos.transform_factor identity; removing a name from its __all__ would pass every COCOS test suite green.

the wheel Requires-Python/Requires-Dist, the clean-venv-3.12 value and the re-export identity are recorded only as table rows here and in the manifest, with no standalone gate log on disk, so a reader cannot reconcile those three done-when elements against a command transcript.
the member pyproject ends without a trailing newline, which the repository's ruff/format convention supplies; a style defect only.

item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to make the COCOS factor algebra installable as the workspace member nova-cocos; packages/nova-cocos/src/nova_cocos/__init__.py lands it.

justifications.durability: tests/test_io_cocos.py fails on a mutation of nova_cocos (negative-control.log EXIT=1, 8 FAILED), but nova/io/cocos.py:1 re-exports with no test asserting it, so dropping a name there passes the whole suite.
justifications.evidence: base-arm.log and head-arm.log record 105 passed EXIT=0 in each arm, but the wheel-METADATA, clean-venv-3.12 and re-export-identity elements of the done-when are recorded only as manifest/evidence-fragment values with no standalone gate log.
justifications.fit: packages/nova-cocos/pyproject.toml mirrors the root hatchling/hatch-vcs shape and the src layout follows the idiom; the only blemish is a missing trailing newline at packages/nova-cocos/pyproject.toml:47.
